issue.title: [mavsdk-python SITL] mavsdk-server crashes when reading EulerAngle
issue.body:
I am using mavsdk-python to control my drone in offboard mode. I had problems when trying to use the EulerAngle and reading them in a cycle around 20 Hz.  After some seconds the mavsdk-server will crash. First I thought it was a problem with the use of global variables in python, but after commenting out the lines which read the EulerAngle, it runs perfectly.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Switch on SITL(PX4)


2. Start my python program (fcc_bug.py)
3. Start a Testmessage Script which sends messages to the fcc.py
4. See error

**System Details**
Tested on: macOS 11.2.1 / raspbian buster lite  

<mark>But it does not crash on ubuntu 20.04 (running in a virtual box) </mark>
